name: PakThai 24/7 Engine Runner

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/30 * * * *' # Har 30 minute baad khud ba khud chale ga
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  run-engine:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js / Environment
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Run Sourcing and Store Monitor
        run: |
          echo "Engine is reading project structure and running background sync..."
